purpose: Dense list row with leading, status, title, time, description, meta, and trailing slots; the status-first two-line row has a fixed 128px status column, a two-line title clamp and a whole-row link.
useWhen: Listing entities vertically with consistent leading icons or avatars and trailing actions.
Linking each row to a detail view by passing href, which makes the whole row one link.
Listing runs, goals, schedules or agents with a status word, bold title and time on line one and muted meta on line two.

avoidWhen.reason: Comparing tabular data across columns — use table instead.
Rendering cards in a responsive grid — use grid-list instead.
